# truenas_resilver_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS pool resilver priority schedule. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one resilver schedule per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `begin` (String) Time when the resilver operations window begins, 24-hour "HH:MM" format.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resilver schedule is enabled.
- `end` (String) Time when the resilver operations window ends, 24-hour "HH:MM" format.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "resilver_config".
- `weekday` (List of Number) Weekdays when resilver operations are allowed, crontab(5) values 1 (Monday) through 7 (Sunday).
